title: Managed IT Services (MSP)
summary: 24/7 network monitoring, infrastructure maintenance and system health checks.
problems: IT problems are only noticed after they disrupt the business
Internal staff spend their time firefighting instead of improving systems
Maintenance and patching slip when the team is busy
delivery: We take responsibility for the routine care of your IT environment. Systems are monitored around the clock, maintenance is carried out on a planned basis, and AI-driven predictive monitoring helps us act on warning signs before they become downtime.
value: Internal teams freed to focus on strategic work
